chunks: And in the narration of Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, he said:

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.حَرِيزٍ: Ḥarīz, a narrator in the sanad
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ: Muḥammad ibn Muslim, a prominent narrator transmitting from the Imam

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام mean by "If the blood flows, then eat"?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a concise legal criterion related to slaughtered game or animals: if blood flows out, then eating it is permitted. It is cited from Abū Jaʿfar Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام in the context of hunting and slaughtering rulings.
